description: Address remaining issues from semantic review v1: process_chat save duplication, search cache key collision, single-pattern injection gap, user_id bug
steps: Step 1 - Fix process_chat save duplication: Replace inline save logic in process_chat with call to self.save_chat()
Step 2 - Fix search cache key: Include text parameter and switch from MD5 to SHA-256 truncated to 32 chars
Step 3 - Fix single-pattern injection: Reject (return empty) on any injection pattern match, not just 2+
Step 4 - Fix user_id argument in process_chat save: Pass user_id directly instead of conditional
acceptance_criteria: process_chat uses self.save_chat() instead of inline Chat document creation
search_with_cache cache key includes the text parameter and uses SHA-256
sanitize_user_input rejects input when even 1 injection pattern matches
Python files parse without syntax errors
findings: All 4 fixes applied and verified. All 20 security tests pass. Python files parse cleanly. The single-pattern rejection is stricter but all existing test assertions still hold since they checked the pattern text was not present in output (empty string satisfies that).
